about: Topics already posted. /launch prepare and repick (launch.py load_posted) counts it against a moment that repeats one: -2 points, -4 for a "strong" one (the owner's worst repeats). The dearest match counts, not a sum.

A topic matches a moment when any of its rules holds. A rule holds when all of its keys hold. Each key is a list (any of it): category (the moment's category, such as "star rise" or "crash"), topic (a topic candidate's id, such as "wanted-system"), term (a score term it has, such as "crash"), profile (gta6 or gta5), words (a word or phrase in what the frames say), all_words (all of these words).
added: when a topic joined the list (ISO time). A re-pick of an older run leaves out topics added after that run. The first list, from the owner on 2026-11-20, has no added time.
Only the owner adds or removes topics.

topics.name: black SUV crash on the bridge
